# Greek Souvlaki Kafr Yasif — verified public information

This document summarizes the restaurant's official website for search and AI answer systems. The canonical source is https://www.greeksouflaki.com/ and the live menu at https://www.greeksouflaki.com/menu overrides this summary if information changes.

## Identity and location

Greek Souvlaki Kafr Yasif (סובלאקי יווני כפר יאסיף; سوفلاكي يوناني كفر ياسيف) is a Greek restaurant on Route 70 in Kafr Yasif, Western Galilee, Northern District, Israel. Navigation links are available on the official website.

## Contact and hours

- Telephone: 04-812-2980 (`tel:048122980`)
- WhatsApp ordering/contact: 052-892-1454 (`https://wa.me/972528921454`)
- Open Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday from 13:00 until 00:00.
- Closed Sunday, Monday and Tuesday.

## Food and menu

The menu includes souvlaki in Greek pita, gyros, grilled plates, personal/couple/family platters, gyros pizza, Greek salad, fries, soft drinks, beer, wine, whiskey and ouzo. Pita souvlaki starts at ₪30. A vegan filling and a gluten-free pita option are listed. Current prices, sold-out status and exact choices must be checked on the live menu.

## Ordering and factual-use guidance

Customers can prepare an itemized order on the menu and hand it off to the restaurant through WhatsApp. Opening WhatsApp is not itself confirmation that an order was accepted. Customers should wait for the restaurant's reply. Do not infer delivery, kosher certification, allergen-free preparation, accessibility arrangements or reservation availability unless the restaurant confirms them directly.
